ios.desc:
Visualize your projects and tasks and track their path to completion: Boards is a new Kanban app to boost your productivity for your projects.

SIMPLE PRICING / NO SUBSCRIPTIONS: Boards is a single universal purchase covering all devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac). It includes new feature updates for one year and lifetime bugfix and iOS/macOS compatibility updates.

Includes: 

• iPhone app
• iPad app
• Mac app
• iCloud sync

Features:

Collect your thoughts & ideas, plan your week, or just keep a board with links to your favorite recipes, the possibilities are endless.

Each board can hold multiple lists. Each list can contain task cards, list items, or notes. You can further organize lists with subheadings to create sections within lists.

Capture the outcome of a task, instead of merely crossing off a to do:
Each entry on a board can have a dedicated cover image, a link, as well as notes. This makes it easy to record the results of a phone call or to keep meeting minutes.

Implement your own workflow:

Each list can represent a step in your workflow. By dragging an item from list to list, you see how it progresses towards completion. For example, track which tasks are still in the backlog, which are in progress, blocked, and completed. Or plan a party and keep track of invitations sent and replies yet to be received.

Bonus: Local First Software

• Works Offline, no Internet connection required. Everything is saved on your device. You have full control over your data. 

• Open and accessible file format: each “board” file can be opened even without having the app installed so that you can always access your data (each *.board file is simply a ZIP archive). 


No risk, try before you buy: 

You can download and try Boards for free for all devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac). All features are unlocked from the start, but boards are limited to 20 entries each. Once you a ready, you can buy Boards from within the app with a single In-App purchase covering all devices.

What this app is not:

This app is for personal projects or smaller work projects, this is not a full project management app. No Gantt charts anywhere to be seen.
